clue.text: Tonic for yuppie flu found in truck

indicators.note: something found in a vehicle sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a pickup is a small open-backed truck
yuppie flu was a dismissive nickname for ME, myalgic encephalomyelitis

explanation.surface: A remedy for chronic fatigue turns up in the back of a lorry.
explanation.definitionFit: A pick-me-up is a drink or medicine taken to restore energy, which is what a tonic does.

clue.text: Ring round hospital, terribly angry, relating to top of gullet

indicators.note: the ring goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a peal is a ringing of bells
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

indicators.note: terribly suggests the word is mangled, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A ring around a hospital, very angry, concerning the upper throat.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads Ring as a circle drawn round a hospital; here it is the sound of bells.
explanation.definitionFit: Pharyngeal means of the pharynx, the cavity at the top of the gullet behind the mouth.

clue.text: Complete with skill

definitions.meaning: total or utter, as in an absolute fool
showing great expertise, as a highly accomplished performer

explanation.definitionFit: Consummate means both complete or utter and supremely skilled, as in a consummate professional.

clue.text: Faces made when cattle call loudly?

indicators.note: something said loudly is heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: cattle call by mooing, so their calls are moos

explanation.surface: Grimaces pulled when the cows start lowing noisily.
explanation.definitionFit: A moue is a pouting face, so moues are faces made in displeasure.

clue.text: Fallow deer's head after upset in Tuvalu etc

indicators.note: the deer's head comes after the rearranged letters
upset as in knocked over and disordered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A fallow deer gets upset on a Pacific island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fallow deer' reads as one animal, but the definition is Fallow alone and the deer only supplies its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Fallow land is left unplanted for a season, so it is not cultivated.

clue.text: Not up yet, embracing a model that's gone down

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold in the arms, so the first piece wraps round the others

parts.note: someone not up yet is still abed
the Model T was Ford's famous car, so model can stand for T

explanation.surface: A lazy sleeper is still in bed hugging a fashion model whose career has slumped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gone down' must be read as a past participle like subsided, not a description of the model.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has abated has lessened or subsided, as a storm or a fever goes down.

clue.text: Party animal around parts of Santa Fe

indicators.note: the animal goes around the other letters

parts.note: a beast is an animal

indicators.note: parts of means pieces taken out of the words, so a run from Santa and all of Fe

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A party animal hangs around parts of Santa Fe, New Mexico.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party animal' looks like one phrase but Party is the definition. AN comes from inside Santa.
explanation.definitionFit: A beanfeast, or beano, is British slang for a celebratory party or jolly outing.

clue.text: Old musical advice to the fallen: provide the parakeet with a bed …

definitions.text: Old musical advice to the fallen

indicators.note: to provide is to prepare or make ready, so the letters are made up into a new order

parts.note: ... as written
... as written

explanation.surface: An instruction to give a pet parakeet somewhere to sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: The song is Pick Yourself Up, from the 1936 film Swing Time, whose advice runs on through the next two linked answers.
explanation.definitionFit: The song Pick Yourself Up offers this advice to someone who has fallen, before telling them to get up again.

clue.text: … and, after a 1 across, Springfield to suffer fool badly

parts.note: Dusty Springfield was a British pop singer

indicators.note: badly signals the words are put together wrongly, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Following a tonic, a singer struggles to put up with an idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: '1 across' leads the solver to the song line beginning pick yourself up. 'badly' turns SUFFERFOOL into OURSELFOFF.
explanation.definitionFit: In the song, after picking yourself up you brush away the dirt from the fall; that is the next line.

clue.text: Make known girl wait, say

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
wait sounds like weight, and say marks an example: an ounce is a weight

explanation.surface: A request to publicise that a girl called Ann is waiting.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce something is to declare it publicly, to make it known.

clue.text: Pacific resort's holding king and queen of Sheba

indicators.note: one piece holds the other, so the king goes inside

parts.note: Bali is an Indonesian island resort, loosely in the Pacific; its possessive gives BALI'S
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A tropical island hosts a royal couple, the Queen of Sheba among them.
explanation.definitionFit: Balkis is the name Arabic tradition gives to the biblical Queen of Sheba.

clue.text: Agree where to play?

parts.note: to concert is to arrange by agreement
a pitch is a sports field

explanation.surface: A question about agreeing which venue to play at.
explanation.definitionFit: Concert pitch is the agreed standard tuning to which instruments play together.

clue.text: See 8
Monkey and queen with musical backing? It's a must

parts.note: a monkey is a mischievous child, an imp
ER is Elizabeth Regina, Queen Elizabeth

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: Evita is the Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: A monkey and a queen performing with a band behind them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses EVITA to ATIVE; 'musical backing' looks like accompaniment.
explanation.definitionFit: An imperative is something essential, a must.

clue.text: Whisky is a stimulant to a savoury

definitions.note: the plural dish, here thought of as one item on a menu

parts.note: Scotch is whisky from Scotland
something that eggs on urges or stimulates

explanation.surface: A dram of whisky gives an appetite for a savoury snack.
explanation.walkthrough: Scotch eggs, boiled eggs wrapped in sausage meat and breadcrumbs, are a British picnic food.
explanation.definitionFit: Scotch eggs are a savoury snack of a boiled egg in sausage meat coated with breadcrumbs.

clue.text: Died with face put back by lady's fingers

indicators.note: putting back turns the sequence round, so the letters run in the opposite direction

parts.note: OB is short for Latin obiit, he or she died, seen on gravestones
mug is slang for face

explanation.surface: Someone died after a lady's fingers shoved their face backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' reverses the whole of OB + MUG. Lady's fingers is the British name for okra, the vegetable that thickens gumbo.
explanation.definitionFit: Gumbo is another name for okra, the pod vegetable also called lady's fingers.

clue.text: See 22
Islamic leader missing his Mecca due to shortage of blood

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter
missing in the sense of amiss or gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A Muslim leader is unable to make his pilgrimage to Mecca.
explanation.walkthrough: The I from 'Islamic leader' joins HISMECCA and 'missing' scrambles all nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Ischaemic describes tissue starved of blood supply because an artery is restricted.

clue.text: So long, Johnny? Just after Matthew's lost terminals

indicators.note: the second piece comes after the first
the word has lost its end points, its first and last letters

parts.note: the name Matthew, its 's being has
just means fair

explanation.surface: A farewell to someone called Johnny, just after Matthew lost his stations.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition recalls the old song: Oh dear, what can the matter be? Johnny's so long at the fair.
explanation.definitionFit: In the folk song the singer complains that Johnny is so long at the fair, so this phrase completes the line.

clue.text: Doctor to negotiate for a party

definitions.meaning: to doctor a patient is to give them medical care
a special outing or entertainment laid on for others

explanation.surface: A physician bargains on behalf of a political party.
explanation.definitionFit: The one word means to give medical care, to negotiate terms, and a special entertainment or outing.

clue.text: See 7
Dangerous stuff contributing to gastric influenza

indicators.note: contributing to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something nasty that adds to a bout of stomach flu.
explanation.definitionFit: Ricin is a deadly poison from castor beans, a truly dangerous substance.

clue.text: After 8 12, go back to square 1 and spring up ('ow-d'ye-do, Lynn) with profit

parts.note: to spring up is to jump suddenly in surprise
a Cockney greeting, hallo with its H dropped
Vera Lynn was the wartime forces' sweetheart singer
a profit is a gain

explanation.surface: Begin from scratch and leap up to greet Vera Lynn for a profit.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening 'After 8 12' ties this to the previous line of the song Pick Yourself Up.
explanation.definitionFit: To go back to square one is to begin from the very beginning once more.

clue.text: see 22
Leaves (or 8) in this to be potted

definitions.text: Leaves (or 8) in this to be potted

parts.words: Leaves (or 8) in this to be potted
parts.note: tea leaves, or the fine powdery grade of tea meant by entry 8, sit in a little sachet that goes into the pot

explanation.surface: Something left behind waits to be potted like a snooker ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea bag holds tea leaves or fine powdered tea and is put in a teapot to brew.

clue.text: Providing with calf here?

definitions.meaning: supplying goods, as a shop stocks up its shelves
a calf of the leg is covered by hosiery

explanation.surface: A farmer wonders whether to supply a young cow here.
explanation.definitionFit: Stocking means supplying with goods, and a stocking is hosiery that covers the calf of the leg.

clue.text: Give way given to previous borrower

definitions.meaning: to yield or soften one's stance
lent again, re- plus lent, to someone who borrowed before

explanation.surface: Giving way by passing something to whoever borrowed it last.
explanation.definitionFit: To relent is to yield or soften, and read as re-lent it means lent a second time.

clue.text: Game about an inch length, for a wonder

indicators.note: about means around, so the game surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: chess is a board game

explanation.surface: A board game takes an inch of space, which is something of a marvel.
explanation.walkthrough: A chinless wonder is British slang for a feeble, upper-class young man, so the answer is the word that goes before wonder.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom chinless wonder names a weak, privileged twit, so this word is what precedes wonder.
